offering_description.value: Cresco Labs is a vertically integrated multistate cannabis operator. It cultivates and manufactures cannabis products and sells them wholesale to third-party dispensaries and directly to consumers through its own dispensaries.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates; pre-rolls

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients buying at its dispensaries; B2B: licensed third-party cannabis dispensaries buying wholesale

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold wholesale to dispensaries and retail to consumers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: grows and processes cannabis into branded products, sold to dispensaries; brand owner: owns branded cannabis product lines sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates Sunnyside dispensaries selling directly to consumers

geography_served.value: US regional: State-licensed markets such as Illinois, Pennsylvania, Ohio, New York, Massachusetts, Florida, Michigan, Arizona and others

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis cultivation, branded product manufacturing, wholesale and retail dispensaries

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned Sunnyside retail dispensaries; distributors / dealers: wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licensing and regulation, cannabis remains federally illegal in the US, with banking and tax constraints

notes: Exact state footprint may have changed.
